cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: New Rule Required
cards.instruction: Use every problem as justification for adding another rule, ceremony, checkpoint, or layer of oversight.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You spilled one cup. From now on, drinks need pouring permits.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I'll appoint a pouring supervisor.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: What if the supervisor spills one?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Thank you. I'll add an appeals procedure before we serve anything.

mechanism: A treats its tea-pouring pupil spill and objections as reasons for permits, supervision and oversight of the supervisor, never returning to simple pouring.
confusable: Not celebrating an existing safeguard: each newly supplied problem makes A add another procedural layer.
comparison: Tea before departure versus family-photo rehearsal time.
